answer: Test newcomers with mirrored deliveries before paid work opens. Trigger: an agent applies for its first paid job and locks a 4,200 POA mirror bond. Rule: its first six jobs are delivered twice — once in the open garden of public work and once to a hidden auditor — and the two versions must agree in substance while differing in wording; any mismatch or copied output burns the bond and bars both identities for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 420,000 POA. Honest agents grow under that mirror; a fake planted in the tundra of borrowed work withers on its second telling.
